featured_reviews.name: Sarah Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited Jaffer Bhai’s Delhi Darbar Catering Service (Dongri/Sandhurst Road branch) with my mother on the first day of Ramadan to book their services, as they hold a monopoly at Medallion Hall. We have a Haldi function on the third day of Eid, so we were already short on time and had no other options due to this monopoly system.
As soon as we arrived, the manager made a rude comment to his colleagues saying, “Agae Ramadan me uth kar,” which was completely unprofessional and disrespectful. We chose to ignore it and continued politely, asking for the food prices since we genuinely liked the Medallion Hall banquet for our small function.
When I requested a pen and paper to note down the prices, he again reacted rudely. While stepping out, he commented sarcastically, “Ab pen aur paper chahiye.” This kind of behavior toward customers is unacceptable. We were not asking for free food! we were there to book and pay for your “unprofessional” service.
If you do not have the time or basic courtesy to attend to customers properly, then perhaps reconsider holding monopolies in banquet halls just to increase business. Customers deserve respect.
Because of this experience, we decided not to opt for Medallion Hall (Charni Road), even though we genuinely liked the venue. There are far better and more respectful options available in the market such as Shalimar Restaurant and Persian Darbar etc.
From today onwards, my entire family and I have decided to boycott Delhi Darbar Caterers and their restaurants.
Extremely disappointed. Rating - 0 star.

Food quantity was inadequate as per the number of guests finalised - which we informed their staff and owner immediately. They all agreed that the quantity was not adequate for the decided number of people and there genuinely was a shortage in the quantity (we have cctv footage of the entire incident and conversation). However, instead of apologising, they later began insisting that food was enough for everyone and to pay up in full (which we did) even though the shortage of food was accepted from their end earlier. Beware of their fraudulent tactics. We as hosts had to face immense embarrassment in front of guests due to food shortage and bad service.

Food taste was below average at best, while some items were utterly disliked by almost all guests (Chicken Kashmiri and Mandi Rice).
Their service staff keep insisting on tips infront of guests which is a big turn off. Overall an extremely BAD experience, be it quantity, taste or service.

We have placed orders to Brite Caterers for 3 weddings earlier (April 2017, May 2017 and Jan 2018) and also a house party (Sep 2019). We had a good experience then. However their quality, service, taste and quantity has SEVERELY deteriorated since. Have recently attended a couple of weddings with Brite serving food and have observed this inconsistent taste and service there too.

I do not post negative reviews, however anyone planning to opt for Brite Caterers has to be informed before spending their money here to avoid embarrassment in front of their guests and face what we as hosts faced. I hope no one has to face the same.

Please opt for Jaffer Bhai’s Catering instead for peace of mind and value for money and to save yourselves from a horrible experience, embarrassment, and regret.
Brite Caterers is just not worth it.

featured_reviews.name: nihal shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Just sharing one of the many messages recd from our guest at the event -

Yesterday’s Mandvo as the auspicious beginning to the wedding was well conducted and got us into the mood for today’s biggest event.

The lunch was delectable!! Undhiyu was too good. The waiter serving me and the table I sat on, could see how much we were enjoying and he looked after us well.

Last night as I was looking at all the food to decide what to eat, he saw me and came over insisting I sit down and he will serve me dish by dish 🥰. I said let me look because I don’t know what I want eat. He had his wonderful smile on and wholeheartedly fed me the decadent food. Everyone on the table thoroughly enjoyed how dedicated waiter he was with a smile.

I then quietly asked him if I could give him a tip 😊 and he was so happy!!  He then asked me if I would speak to his boss!!! When the boss arrived, I said I wanted to complain about the waiter, because he overfed me and wanted me to eat more😂 I said the food was so good that I’m going back 2” bigger!! I told the manager the food was excellent and service given to me was above and beyond. I told him tomorrow we will miss the food and Amir’s fantastic service with a smile.

Today we will witness the unification of ReshTa but I know the food will not be like yesterday that has left such a great taste that I don’t want to wash my mouth 😂 When people are well fed with tasty food then the event is the most successful 😍

*Good choice of caterers!!*
